**mac/mac-mbp**: pass on #693, dev-swift @ 9f7ec2b8. **Partial**: code re-measure of every matrix cell done; the light / dark / Dynamic Type XL screenshots are **not done** (see Blocked). No screenshot is attached.

### Blocked
- iPhone 18 Pro, iOS 27.2, kit account logged in (hosted login ok), Favoris at light / default size loaded fine. A system « Autoriser HFR à vous envoyer des notifications ? » alert covers every screen of a fresh simulator; `simctl privacy` cannot answer it and this Mac has no tap tooling (no Simulator process for System Events, no idb / cliclick / axe, no UI-test target). So no dark / XL captures; swipes, context menus and tab reselect cannot be driven either.
- The one capture taken shows real pseudos and an avatar, so it was deleted, not kept. iPad not run.
- To finish: an in-app scratch driver that answers the permission (or a launch argument that skips the request), and a UI-test target or hosted gestures.

### Cells re-measured in the code (matrix says gap, dev-swift says done)

| Reader | Haptics | gap → #1310 | done: « Actualiser » plays start and end (`ReaderPageEnd.swift:80-115`) |
| Messages | Row context menu | gap → #676 and #1311 | #1311 done (`MessageListView.swift:46-53`); « Marquer non lu » / « Supprimer » still #676 (open) |
| Recherche (forum) | Row context menu | gap → #1311 | done: `TopicRowMenu` with `.globalSearch` (`ForumSearchView.swift:116-122`) |
| Profile | Haptics | gap → #1310 | #1310 closed: legacy's only haptic is the smiley toggle, not ported; no gap row owns it |

**mac/mac-mbp**: screenshot pass on #693, iPhone 18 Pro (iOS 27.2), dev-swift @ 9f7ec2b8, kit test account. 28 images, light and dark, default size and Accessibilité XL (`accessibility-extra-large`), pseudos and avatars blanked (opaque rectangles, each checked by eye). They are on the Mac, not attached (no hosting): the orchestrator shares them.

Screens shot (each in the 4 combinations): Favoris, Messages, Catégories (forum list), a category's topic list, the reader (first page of a topic), Plus, Recherche (from Plus). The notification prompt is skipped with `-mp_notifications_enabled NO -mp_badge_enabled NO` (scratch launch arguments).

**Not done**: iPad (the Mac was at a load average of 500+ from other simulators, my run never got a slot and was stopped), and everything that needs a gesture: pull to refresh, swipes, context menus, tab reselect, haptics. Those stay verified in code only (previous comment).

| Row of the matrix | What the screenshots show vs the matrix |
|---|---|
| Catégories, Loading / empty / error | Loaded state only; failure and empty states are not reachable without an offline switch. #1309 stays as decided. |
| Topic list, Row swipes / menus | Not shown (gestures). The list itself is as the matrix describes: pinned and locked icons, a « Tous / Favoris / Suivis / Lus » filter, a « Sous-forum » picker. |
| Favoris | Sections « Hardware - Périphériques » and « Apple » with fold chevrons, filter and « … » buttons in the top bar: same as the matrix. |
| Messages | « Tous / MP / MP multiples » switch, « non lu » capsule plus accent dot and tint on unread rows: as GAP-227. |
| Recherche | Form (Catégorie, Dans, Début / 5 ans / 1 an, « Rechercher »): matches « inline rows as legacy » for the form; results not shot. |
| Reader | Pill title, refresh and « … » buttons, no tab bar while a topic is open: as GAP-008 (UXD-02). |
| Light / dark | No contrast or tint problem seen; selected segments, tint pills and glass bars read correctly in both. |
| Accessibilité XL | **Four layout problems**, opened as #1439: Messages row title squeezed to one word per line, reader body indented about 40 % of the width, « Sous-forum » label clipped by its card, meta lines truncating the date and wrapping « 452 / 452 ». |

The ledger-note of the previous comment stands; nothing in the screenshots changes it.
